Task complete. Summary:

- **`out/T3/solution.py`**: standalone PyTorch/safetensors script that reads `inputs/base/model.safetensors`, casts the 64 named projection matrices to bfloat16, upcasts every other tensor to float32, drops the 48 named non-parameter buffers, runs the four required assertions, then greedily bin-packs the 196 remaining tensors into shards (≤256 MiB tensor data each, oversized tensors alone) and writes `out/T3/model.safetensors.index.json` plus the shard files.
- Ran on the first execution — no retries needed.
- Verified independently: 196 tensors total (64 bf16 / 132 f32), `query_key_value.weight` layer 0 is bf16, `embed_in.weight` is f32, all 48 buffers absent, values bit-exact against `tensor.to(dtype)` on the source, and every shard's tensor-data total is within the 256 MiB budget (the two embedding tensors land alone in their own shards since they exceed it at float32 size, ~412 MB each — note the task's "206 MB each" refers to the float16 input size, not the float32 output size).
- `out/T3/REPORT.md` written with the self-report, flagging that embed-tensor-size nuance as the one pitfall worth calling out.
